name: Bacon & Broccoli Mac and Cheese
method: Cook the penne, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Meanwhile grill the bacon until crisp and chop.
Melt the butter, stir in the cornflour and mustard, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick. Stir in most of the cheddar.
Toss with the pasta and broccoli, scatter the bacon and remaining cheese over the top and grill for 3 minutes.
